description: April has more than 30 years’ experience in communications law, regulatory affairs and advocacy across a broad spectrum of private sector and non-profit engagements. She most recently served as the Deputy Assistant Secretary for Communications in President Biden’s Commerce Department and prior to that appointment, was the Washington Director and a board member of Common Sense Media, a leading non-profit dedicated to how media impacts kids' health and well-being.
